# Antisystem Barbershop

> Italian barbershop at 124B Roscoe St, Bondi Beach NSW 2026, Australia.
> Men's cuts, skin fades, beard trims and the Italian beard trim with shave.
> Opened by Andrea, an Italian barber. Walk-ins taken when a chair is free;
> booking is not required but is the only way to be sure of a time.

## Contact
- Phone: 0452 137 237 (+61 452 137 237)
- Email: andrea@antisystem.com.au
- Website: https://www.antisystem.com.au/
- Bookings: https://www.fresha.com/a/antisystem-barbershop-bondi-beach-124b-roscoe-st-eo3zz9kd
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/antisystem_barbershop/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@antisystembarbershop

## Hours (Sydney time)
- Monday: 12pm – 7pm
- Tuesday: 9am – 7pm
- Wednesday: 9am – 7pm
- Thursday: 9am – 7pm
- Friday: 9am – 7pm
- Saturday: 8am – 4pm
- Sunday: Closed

## Services and prices
- Men's Cut — 30 min, $66 AUD
- Restyle — 45 min, $80 AUD
- Skin fade only — 30 min, $55 AUD
- Buzz cut — 20 min, $40 AUD
- Under 18 Cuts — 30 min, $50 AUD
- Beard Trim — 15 min, $35 AUD
- The Italian beard trim with shave — 30 min, $65 AUD
- Men's Cut + Beard Trim — 45 min, $90 AUD

## Barbers
Andrea, Gracie and Dave. Any of the three can be chosen when booking on Fresha.

## Area
Bondi Beach, Bondi, North Bondi, Bondi Junction, Tamarama and Bronte.

## What Antisystem does not offer
- No hot towel straight razor shave, head shave, or full face shave of any kind.
  The razor work on the menu is the finish to a beard trim, on the cheeks and neck.
- The entrance has a step, so it is not wheelchair accessible.
- Closed on Sundays.

## Previous name
The shop at this address was formerly Bondi Barber Lounge, under different
ownership. Listings still carrying that name are out of date; the business
operating at 124B Roscoe St is Antisystem Barbershop.
